verses.7:18: قَالَ ٱخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا مَذۡءُومࣰ ا مَّدۡحُورࣰ اۖ لَّمَن تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

meaning: The root ذأم (dhAm) primarily signifies blame, censure, or finding fault with someone or something. It implies a strong disapproval or disparagement, often leading to disgrace or contempt.
